code: cbytes = sw32_(src);      /* amount of compressed bytes */
note: Attacker-controlled negative compressed-size token read from the chunk block; cbytes < 0 selects the token-encoded decoding path.
When the token's low bit is clear this branch is skipped: nbytes is never assigned and cbytes is never normalized to 0, so the loop epilogue operates on stale values.
Loop epilogue rewinds the source pointer by the stale negative cbytes value.
Loop epilogue reads the never-initialized nbytes and folds it into ntbytes; the tainted ntbytes is returned and branched on by serial_blosc, producing the use-of-uninitialized-value defect.
